# WebStudio (uriy-as.org)

> WebStudio is a Ukraine-based digital development studio creating websites, AI-powered Telegram bots, and science content for Telegram channels.

## Services
- Website development: landing pages, business card sites, online stores, corporate sites
- AI Telegram bots: customer support, sales automation, lead collection
- Science articles for Telegram channels
- SEO promotion and content marketing
- Automation: n8n / Make, API integrations with CRM, webhooks, scripts

## Tech Stack
- HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (vanilla)
- Python Flask for backend/API
- GitHub Pages for hosting
- Schema.org JSON-LD (Article, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, HowTo, LocalBusiness)
- AI/LLM integration with automatic model fallback chain

## Pricing
- Website from $250
- Telegram bot from $130
- Science articles from $50
- SEO promotion from $70/month
